public_coverage_observation.note: Public metadata only; not an authenticated odds response, not a guarantee of current Serie A quote coverage.

timestamps.quote_last_update_semantics: Provider engine last-read time per bookmaker price; not a bookmaker-native quote-change timestamp.
timestamps.required_admission: source archive completed before quote last_update; last_update and effective per-book kickoff strictly before kickoff; response generated_at and local receipt time recorded; reject missing or suspended 1X2 legs.

current_v2_contract.quote_source: Existing saved SERIE_A 1X2 quote observations from the existing read-only Supabase ledger; this workflow never calls an odds provider.

reasons: The frozen V2 quote-source contract is limited to existing saved SERIE_A 1X2 observations and does not authorize a new provider path.
The free plan is described for internal model analysis, but long-term raw-data retention rights are not explicit in the reviewed materials.
The history endpoint is not active, so no historical backfill is available.
The public status snapshot reports a non-trivial stale-price tail and was itself stale at this audit time.
Provider event IDs cannot be assumed to match existing Supabase event IDs.
No account, key, authenticated request, or permission to change the frozen quote-source contract was supplied.
